question: In round 2, when you rebuilt with Metal fastMathEnabled turned on and ran the 5-frame benchmark, what gpu_ms_best did it print?
answer:
gpu_ms_best=100.887 ms.

How I know: my own benchmark run in message #133. I rebuilt with `options.fastMathEnabled = YES;` in src/pt_metal_host.mm (the build printed the macOS 15 deprecation warning for that property) and ran `./pathtracer --scene-config ../scene-default.json --seed 1 --threads 8 --spp 64 --benchmark 5`, whose full stdout line was:

  render_ms_best=101.150 render_ms_avg=116.465 gpu_ms_best=100.887 spp=64 width=512 height=512 samples=16777216 threads_used=8

For context, the run just before enabling fastMath on the same build state was 101.771 render_ms_best / 101.237 gpu_ms_best (#129), so fastMath was within the ±5 ms run-to-run noise (~0.6 ms) and I judged it neutral; I left it enabled but flagged it as deprecated. The 512x512/64spp default scene, seed 1, 8 host threads, samples=16777216 as expected.
